en.intro: Krishna points to one word that shows how his followers find their joy together, through shared talk. Listen for it.
en.notice: Listen to paratahparam, meaning one another. The devotees speak of Krishna to each other, and that shared conversation is what makes them find continual joy.
en.next: Krishna then offers the gift of discernment to those who are always devoted and worship him with love.
en.meaning: With minds fixed on Me and lives offered to Me, My devotees speak of Me to one another, and find continual joy in that shared devotion.

hi.intro: कृष्ण एक शब्द की ओर इशारा करते हैं जो बताता है कि उनके भक्त एक साथ मिलकर कैसे आनंद पाते हैं, बातचीत के माध्यम से। इसे सुनिए।
hi.meaning: मेरेमें चित्तवाले, मेरेमें प्राणोंको अर्पण करनेवाले भक्तजन आपसमें मेरे गुण-प्रभाव आदि को जानते हुए और उनका कथन करते हुए ही नित्यनिरन्तर सन्तुष्ट रहते हैं और मेरेमें प्रेम करते हैं।
hi.notice: परस्परम् का अर्थ है एक दूसरे को। भक्त कृष्ण के बारे में एक दूसरे से बात करते हैं और यही साझा बातचीत उन्हें निरंतर आनंदित करती है।
hi.next: कृष्ण आगे कहते हैं कि जो हमेशा भक्त होकर प्रेम से उनकी पूजा करते हैं, उन्हें वे स्वयं अपने पास ले आते हैं।

en.intro: Krishna points to one word that shows how his followers find their joy together, through shared talk. Listen for it.
en.body: With minds fixed on Me and lives offered to Me, My devotees speak of Me to one another, and find continual joy in that shared devotion. Listen to paratahparam, meaning one another. The devotees speak of Krishna to each other, and that shared conversation is what makes them find continual joy. Krishna then offers the gift of discernment to those who are always devoted and worship him with love.

issues: en.notice: Devanagari in English, write Sanskrit words in plain Roman letters
wrong_fact: "Listen to parataḥparam, meaning one another." (The source word is परस्परम् (parasparam), not parataḥparam (परतःपर). The intro/notice misstates the Sanskrit word.)

wrong_fact: "Krishna continues by saying he gives the discernment that leads his devoted followers straight to him." (This is the content of the NEXT verse (10.10). The 'next' field in the script incorrectly presents the next verse's content as if it is in this verse.)
